ticket.summary: FedEx Pickup location at checkout — US storefront
acceptanceCriteria: Guest and signed-in shoppers can search FedEx Pickup by ZIP on checkout shipping step
Selecting a location shows name, address, distance, and hours
Place Order stays disabled until a location is chosen when Pickup is selected
Billing address is still required and is not overwritten by the pickup location
Change limited to US storefront only — UK/AU unchanged
ticket.qaNote: Only checkout shipping + Place Order. No cart, PDP, or tracking cases.

byMr.label: Region

bugs.title: Same pickup change present on region fork
bugs.problem: Port carries US-scoped feature into a fork outside ticket scope. Copied from Primary review — store-scope never auto-cleared.

byMr.note: Same normalized diff as Primary — reviewed once there; findings tagged onto this MR.

byMr.label: Theme
byMr.note: Third live MR in the same ticket. Identical shared files skipped; locale + conflict checks still ran per MR.

codeReview.generationLink: Multi-MR: every loaded live MR is reviewed in one run. Confirmed bugs become F items (shared defects fold to one checklist line naming every MR). Log-only findings (SEC-LOG) never become cases.

qualityGate.note: Pass = every parameter ≥ 70/100. Weakest parameter caps the overall score — a strong AC score cannot hide a weak dedup.

findings.issue: One Explore journey restated a ledger item almost verbatim.

merges.kept: #7 ZIP search returns nearby FedEx locations
folded: #19 Search pickup by postal code shows results
#31 Nearby facilities list after ZIP enter

talkingPoints: Angara GenAI Agent is one platform: author → review → run → triage → publish — not a chatbot bolted on.
Generate is quality-gated (7 params; weakest caps). Dedupe merges; coverage guard blocks bad merges.
Multi-MR code review runs while cases draft; shared diffs reviewed once; confirmed bugs become checklist F items.
CUA + Automation execute on real browsers; bugs stay human-gated.
MCP skills bring the same workflows into Cursor / Claude / CLI with project knowledge RAG.
